Proposed exotic-only electric melter, restoring a useful role rather than ordinary duplicate processing. Two graphite heater electrodes descend from the electrum bus into a five-sheet tungsten-lined Fireproof Chemical Vat. Side steel pipes carry its melt; the lower completed-board/Engineering-Processor control cabinet and capacitor sit on a static steel frame. Two Refined Radiance supports lock the construction after nuclear-tier tooling but before first Vibranium, Shadow or Quantum. Native ordinary melter routes remain retired; expensive electric demand belongs to the separate real Melter processing recipes, not a fictitious construction power parameter. This proposes a reviewed exception to the old duplicate-machine decision; it does not enable/install/export the machine.
